actions.action: Check whether the soil is still damp a few days after watering
Inspect leaf crevices and soil surface with a magnifier or phone zoom for algae or mealybugs
Wipe algae off leaves with a cloth or swab and rubbing alcohol
If mealybugs are found, dab each bug with an alcohol-dipped swab
Position the LED grow light 4–6 inches above the plants
Set the grow light on a timer for 12–14 hours a day
Water thoroughly only when the soil is completely dry and let it drain
If the soil stays wet, repot into a gritty mix of 50% or more pumice, perlite, or coarse sand
While repotting, check the roots and trim any that are mushy or black
Move the plants out of humid, stagnant air

reason: It correctly identifies light-starved etiolation as the main cause but recommends only a closer grow light rather than restoring window sun, wrongly says the colour won't return, and has the owner wipe the leaves with alcohol, which strips the protective farina.
